name: abi_step_zero
title: ABI: step(0) is a no-op that preserves the dirty flag
description: Two step(0) calls between poke and peek must neither advance the thermometer nor clear dirty: the following output peek reads 1 (one hidden tick), not 0 (dirty lost) nor 3 (steps executed). A step(1) afterwards must clear dirty: the next peek is tickless.
